title: NBI files qualified human trafficking, firearms cases vs. 9 in Zamboanga Sibugay scam hub
summary: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has filed criminal cases against nine individuals following a raid on suspected scam hubs in Alicia and Siay, Zamboanga Sibugay, on October 2, 2026.
